name: Zombie November
tagline: The candy is gone. The neighbors aren't.

npcMonsters.name: Shambles
npcMonsters.clue: A slow groan. Something is dragging its feet toward you...

npcMonsters.name: Zombie Mailman
npcMonsters.clue: Someone is moaning about a package that needs a signature...

npcMonsters.name: Coach Rot
npcMonsters.clue: A whistle, then: "BRAAAINS! Two more laps!"

npcMonsters.name: The Lurker
npcMonsters.clue: The shadows on the sidewalk start to move...

candy: A survivor tosses you a ration bar. It counts as candy.
trick: A zombie trips you and eats a candy bar. Wrapper and all.
You hide in a closet. The candy does not survive.
